cases.name: identity_integer
cases.note: an integer identity column: refused, naming the type?

observations.message: datatype integer not supported, identity column type must be bigint

cases.name: identity_smallint

observations.message: datatype smallint not supported, identity column type must be bigint

cases.name: identity_bigint_by_default
